tasks.title: outputs: Expo board skeleton on ScenarioStateSource
tasks.goal: A Vite + TypeScript app in web/ whose expo route lists tickets, plates and verdicts from a StateSource interface, backed for now by an in-browser ScenarioStateSource that replays a contracts/scenarios file. The SpacetimeDB source comes later from the partner's TS bindings.
acceptance: web/src/state/ defines a StateSource interface exposing tickets, entities, verdicts and verdict steps with subscribe callbacks shaped like the tables in contracts/state-tables.md

ScenarioStateSource loads any contracts/scenarios/*.json, replays events over time and emits verdicts from the scenario's expected entries: `npm --prefix web test` passes a test that loads every golden scenario
The expo route renders the ticket list, plates and each verdict's decision; the pass badge renders only when decision == 'pass': vitest render test passes
`npm --prefix web run build` succeeds, and a type:request asks platform to run web build and test in CI
Until platform ships TS types generated from contracts/schemas, a type:request is filed and types live in one file, web/src/types/TEMPORARY.ts, linking to that request
PR includes a screenshot of the expo route running on a golden scenario

tasks.title: outputs: ADR: web framework and app layout
tasks.goal: Pick the UI framework and layout for the tablet, chef and expo screens (one Vite app with routes is the default) and record it in a team ADR.
acceptance: docs/decisions/NNNN-outputs-web-framework.md proposed via PR: options considered, choice, routing, state management, test tooling (vitest), and how the SpacetimeDB TypeScript SDK and MSW mocks fit
Confirms the SpacetimeDB TypeScript SDK works with the chosen framework, citing current docs; unverified claims are marked
Notes tablet constraints (touch targets of at least 44 px, works in a browser on an iPad-class device)

tasks.title: outputs: Gate state machine with ConsoleGate and MockGPIOGate
tasks.goal: A pure gate state machine (idle, pass, hold, fault) in kitchen/gate/service.py that is closed by default and fails to fault, plus the ConsoleGate and MockGPIOGate implementations of GateDriver in kitchen/gate/driver.py.
acceptance: Transitions are a pure function matching the state-machine table in kitchen/gate/README.md: `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k gate_transitions` passes

The default state is closed (idle shows red); only an explicit pass for the plate at the pass and the ticket's current revision opens it: `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k gate_opens_only_on_current_pass -m safety` passes
A verdict feed silent beyond the configured limit, or stale vision health, gives fault: `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k gate_stale_fault -m safety` passes
Any exception inside the driver or state machine gives fault: `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k gate_exception_fault -m safety` passes
MockGPIOGate records every show() call for assertions; ConsoleGate prints the state: `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k gate_fakes` passes

tasks.title: outputs: ConsoleSpeaker and spoken-line formatter
tasks.goal: A Speaker fake (kitchen/gate/voice.py) and a formatter (kitchen/gate/lines.py) that turns verdicts into short spoken lines ('Hold seven', 'Seven, peanut'), dropping stale lines instead of queueing them.
acceptance: The formatter turns ticket numbers into words and produces the hold line from verdict fixtures: `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k voice_format` passes on contracts/fixtures/valid/verdict/*.json
ConsoleSpeaker implements Speaker.say without blocking: `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k console_speaker` passes
A newer line for the same plate replaces an unspoken older one: `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k speaker_drops_stale` passes

tasks.title: outputs: Gate service driven by verdicts via StateClient
tasks.goal: A gate process (kitchen/gate/service.py) that subscribes to verdicts through StateClient and drives GateDriver and Speaker for the plate at the pass, holding on anything other than a current-revision pass.
acceptance: Running every golden scenario through InMemoryStateClient drives MockGPIOGate to the scenario's expected decision: `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k gate_service_scenarios -m safety` passes
A verdict for an older ticket revision than the current one leaves the gate holding (invariant 9): `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k gate_stale_revision -m safety` passes
StateUnavailable or a silent subscription gives fault: `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k gate_service_feed_loss -m safety` passes
The Speaker gets 'Hold <number>' on every hold: `uv run pytest kitchen/gate -k gate_service_voice` passes
Runs with ConsoleGate and ConsoleSpeaker via `uv run python -m kitchen.gate.service --fake`, documented in kitchen/gate/README.md
out_of_scope: Wiring the partner's real StateClient beyond config

tasks.title: outputs: Tablet screen with one-tap questions and send gate
tasks.goal: The tablet route in web/src/tablet/ lets a server type a note, see the parsed constraints, answer one-tap questions and send, with Send disabled until the draft is sendable.
acceptance: Uses an MSW mock server built from kitchen/orders/fakes/http/ examples: vitest tests run without the orders service
Send is disabled while any question is unanswered: `npm --prefix web test -- tablet_send_gate` passes
A 409 unanswered_questions response re-shows the open questions: vitest test passes
jev_unavailable shows a manual-entry form instead of a guessed result: vitest test passes
Touch targets are at least 44 px; PR includes a screenshot

tasks.title: outputs: Expo board held-plate chain view
tasks.goal: For each held plate, the expo board (web/src/expo/) shows the reasons, flagged allergens and the contamination chain step by step with per-step confidence.
acceptance: The chain view renders contracts/fixtures/valid/verdict/hold-peanut.json with both steps, entities, actions and step_confidence: vitest render test passes
Every reason code in verdict.schema.json has a human label: a vitest test enumerates the enum
Plates whose latest verdict is for an older ticket revision show 'rechecking', not pass: vitest test passes
PR includes a screenshot running on the knife-carries-peanut-to-plate scenario

tasks.title: outputs: Connect expo board to SpacetimeDB TS bindings
tasks.goal: Add a SpacetimeDB-backed StateSource (web/src/state/) using the TS bindings generated from the partner's database/, with live subscriptions, while ScenarioStateSource stays for tests and demos. Build against mocked bindings shaped like contracts/state-tables.md; the last step needs the partner's generated bindings.
acceptance: The SpacetimeDB source subscribes to ticket, ticket_constraint, entity, entity_risk, verdict and verdict_step and fills the same store: unit tests with the bindings mocked pass (`npm --prefix web test`)
The source is selected by config or URL parameter; the default in tests is ScenarioStateSource
Connection loss shows a visible 'feed lost' banner and never leaves stale PASS badges on screen: vitest test passes
Once the partner's bindings exist, the PR body includes output from a manual run against a local SpacetimeDB set up per database/README.md

tasks.title: outputs: Chef confirmation screen
tasks.goal: The chef route in web/src/chef/ lists open chef confirmations for unclear bin ingredients and lets the chef pick allergen units, calling POST /v1/profiles/bins/{entity_id}/confirm.
acceptance: Lists open confirmations from the StateSource (chef_confirmation table) with bin label and ingredient: vitest test passes on seeded data
Submitting calls the confirm endpoint (MSW mock) with the chosen allergen_unit_ids; 'none of these' is an explicit choice: vitest test passes
Allergen choices come from contracts/allergen_units.json, never hardcoded: vitest test passes
PR includes a screenshot

tasks.title: outputs: 'Start ticket' button calling vision
tasks.goal: A cook-facing 'start ticket' control that calls vision's POST /v1/plates/start and shows clear errors when no plate, several plates, or an already-bound plate is at the plating spot.
acceptance: Calls POST /v1/plates/start with the ticket_id against an MSW mock: vitest test passes
409 no_plate_at_spot, 409 multiple_plates_at_spot and 409 plate_already_bound show distinct messages, and nothing is assumed bound: vitest test passes
web/README.md documents the web origin to set in VISION_CORS_ORIGINS per contracts/apis.md#http-conventions

tasks.title: outputs: Spike: verify Cartesia Sonic for gate voice
tasks.goal: Document how Cartesia Sonic would be called for short gate lines: auth, streaming vs batch, latency, audio output on the Pi, cost, and offline fallback.
